field_principles.auroc_delta_by_policy: Policy final-energy AUROC minus initial-energy AUROC where valid.
field_principles.best_policy: Highest deterministic utility over energy, token cost, duplicate, and drift terms.
field_principles.continuous_self_learning_task: True because this is the milestone FR-11 memory task.
field_principles.contradiction_rate_by_policy: Fraction of non-clean motifs with conflicting final labels.
field_principles.correctness_delta_by_policy: Policy final correctness rate minus initial correctness rate; no live repair is inferred.
field_principles.duplicate_rate_by_policy: Duplicate output-memory motif rate for the policy.
field_principles.duration_s: Real wall-clock duration; no sleep padding.
field_principles.energy_delta_by_policy: Mean initial energy minus policy final energy.
field_principles.forgetting_regression_count_by_policy: Rows or memory updates that regress energy/correctness.
field_principles.fr11_scaleup_clean: True only when target size, no-mutation, no-live-LLM, drift, forgetting, and non-tautological policy separation checks all pass.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal complete:/blocked_ verdict; prior Exp 2882 flags are disclosed.
field_principles.live_llm_called: False because all rows are local verifier-label replay metadata.
field_principles.memory_drift_by_policy: Contradiction rate plus normalized forgetting, clipped to [0, 1].
field_principles.model_weights_mutated: False because only external memory state is updated.
field_principles.n_examples: The deterministic local labeled replay rows evaluated by every policy.
field_principles.policies_compared: The three policies run on identical examples and seed.
field_principles.random_seed: Controls deterministic corpus selection for every policy.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hashes stable artifact fields, selected rows, and source checksums.
field_principles.source_artifacts: Exp 2869, Exp 2881, and the flagged Exp 2882 artifact loaded first.
field_principles.target_examples_met: Whether the selected local replay set reached at least 50 rows.
field_principles.tests_run: Commands run by the operator/agent for this artifact.
field_principles.token_reduction_by_policy: Policy memory token proxy reduction versus eager per-row writes.

target_examples_note: blocked before local replay set selection
